gaps.title: Отсутствует интеграция фронтенда с API
gaps.jtbd: When I search for a dossier, I want the UI to fetch actual data from the backend, so that I see real employee documents.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search query, When the user clicks search, Then the frontend should call /api/v1/dossier/documents and display the results.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement (Возможность отобрать все связанные документы... с формированием списка для просмотра) - currently DossierSearch.svelte uses hardcoded mock data

gaps.title: Некорректная генерация PDF
gaps.jtbd: When I request a dossier report, I want to receive a correctly formatted PDF file, so that I can print or share the official document.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a generated report, When the user downloads it, Then a valid PDF file containing the summary text should be returned.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement (генерацией итоговой сводной справки по шаблону) - currently EmployeeDossierController simply casts a plaintext string to an application/pdf byte array, resulting in a corrupted file

gaps.title: Отсутствует пагинация для списка документов
gaps.jtbd: When retrieving a list of employee documents, I want the results to be paginated, so that the system and UI are not overwhelmed by large data sets.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search query with many results, When the API returns the list, Then the results should be paginated (e.g., using page and size parameters).
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation - a public list endpoint (/api/v1/dossier/documents) usually needs pagination to handle large datasets effectively
